## Behavior

Describe the user-visible change and why it is needed.

## Verification

- [ ] Root `bun run check` and `bun run test` pass.
- [ ] Plugin `npm run check`, `npm run test`, and `npm run build` pass when affected.
- [ ] `bb plugin types --check` passes when the plugin is affected.
- [ ] README and dbm skills match changed commands or behavior.
- [ ] UI changes include a screenshot.
- [ ] Docker resources created by this change are listed below.
- [ ] Cleanup removed only recorded exact IDs, with proof below.

## Docker resources and cleanup proof

Not applicable unless this change creates or mutates Docker resources.
